| # clcan_fd_isTxEmpty {#clcan_fd_istxempty-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                  |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This function checks if a transmitter of a CAN channel is empty.

 

Remarks:

- Empty means that there are no message in transmitter and Tx buffer (if registered) is empty.

- This function can be used in order to check if a previous message was sent completely on CAN bus.
